scenes.say: I hid three problems in a spreadsheet.
Headphones getting returned like crazy. One region quietly dying. And people buying way more on weekends.
Then I asked three AIs to find them.

scenes.label: ChatGPT
scenes.caption: headphones + falling revenue · missed the region
scenes.say: ChatGPT found the headphones and the falling revenue. Missed the region. Five out of ten.

scenes.label: Claude
scenes.caption: East sales cut in half. then… stopped.
scenes.say: Claude went straight for the region. East sales cut in half, with a chart. And then it just stopped. One insight. Four.

scenes.label: Gemini
scenes.caption: headphones · decline · weak region
scenes.say: Gemini found the headphones, the decline, and the weak region. Six.

scenes.sub: Not one AI found it. AIs don't get weekends.
scenes.say: And the weekend problem? Not one AI found it. Apparently AIs don't get weekends.
Full showdown is live on the channel.
